answer: Anchor identity to a living human: liveness-anchored biometric dedup. Onboarding is a 10-second video reading a phrase ('quill'), expiring in 60 seconds. The system checks liveness, embeds the face, and files its hash in a ferrous ledger; duplicates die on arrival. Re-verified every 30 days; a missed 72-hour window pauses earnings. Deepfakes betray themselves: velvet-smooth skin, no micro-expressions. Cost per fake identity: one person ($15–50 gig work), a $30 camera, ten minutes monthly. 1,000 fakes cost $15,000–50,000 in human fees.
